name: Super Bakers (India) Limited
about: Super Bakers (India) Limited manufactures and sells bread in India. The company offers bread products, such as crustless big slices sandwich, white, milk, fruit, atta, brown, double roti, multigrain, and crustless brown bread; maska, sweet, and burger buns; and bhaji, vada, and super pav. It also provides pizza, garlic, and kulcha bread, as well as chocolate and vanilla creamy fills. The company sells its products under the Super Bread brand. Super Bakers (India) was founded in 1978 and is based in Ahmedabad, India.
